business_scope.primary_industry_name: AI Video Synthesis and Virtual Avatar Generation Software

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: None formally in force; bilateral status is governed by the Amended Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States (2003), which is not a BIT, DTAA, or FTA but provides framework economic and investment protections.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990 (as amended, codified in the Marshall Islands Revised Code), Articles of Incorporation filing and beneficial ownership transparency obligations; Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012 (as amended); Financial Intelligence Unit Regulation 2013; and the Registrar of Corporations' Beneficial Ownership Registration Regulations 2020.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of government-issued passport (biometric data page) for each beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority of the beneficial owner's country of nationality
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized in origin jurisdiction; if origin is a Hague Apostille Convention state, affix apostille; otherwise proceed through consular legalization at the nearest Marshall Islands embassy or authorized consular post

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement dated within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed bank in the jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified by a recognized public notary; apostille or consular legalization required if the document originates outside the Marshall Islands and is relied on by the RMI registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and Ownership Structure Statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Beneficial owner or authorized corporate director of the proposed entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signed before a notary public; signature authentication by apostille or consular legalization where required by the registered agent's internal AML/CFT policies

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or equivalent registry extract for each corporate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or registrar of the shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if issuing registry is in a Convention state; otherwise consular legalization by the issuing state's foreign representative or by the Marshall Islands consular authority for the issuer's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds and source of wealth
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank in the wealth-holder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Originating bank letterhead and branch signature; if relied on for UBO verification, the letter must be notarized or apostilled/consularized upon request of the RMI compliance officer

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all proposed directors, shareholders, signatories, and beneficial owners against OFAC SDN and primary sanctions lists, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and RMI domestic terrorism finance designations before any incorporation filing. Screening must be repeated at least every 24 hours during the formation window and upon any material ownership change. Any positive PEP match triggers Enhanced Due Diligence, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, senior management approval, and ongoing transaction monitoring commensurate with a low-risk AIGC video SaaS licensing model.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations (ROC) eRegistry — Name Reservation Module (accessed through licensed RMI registered agents)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be submitted in English using Latin script only. Non-Latin scripts, diacritical marks, or characters outside the basic Latin alphabet are not accepted. Any foreign-language brand name must be transliterated into an English phonetic equivalent, and each proposed name must contain one of the following statutory suffixes or approved abbreviation: Corporation, Incorporated, Limited, Company, Corp., Inc., Ltd., or Co.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name reservation is valid for 30 calendar days and may be extended for one additional 30-day period by filing a Name Reservation Extension Request with the Registrar of Corporations before the initial window expires. If the name is rejected, the applicant or authorized agent must submit a written Name Clearance Appeal to the Registrar within 30 calendar days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds for review and attaching the original reservation request and rejection response. The Registrar shall issue a decision within 15 business days. If the second rejection is sustained, the applicant may apply for judicial review before the High Court of the Marshall Islands within 30 days under the applicable rules of civil procedure.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted. A non-resident Business Corporation must maintain a registered office in the Republic of the Marshall Islands, but that office may be the physical street address of the licensed registered agent. The corporation itself is not required to maintain employees, physical premises, or local assets. A fully virtual AI video synthesis and avatar generation SaaS business may operate from any jurisdiction while satisfying the statutory registered office requirement through the RMI registered agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. For a non-resident BC with no local physical activity and using recognized payment rails (Stripe, Paddle), the annualized probability of unannounced on-site inspection is estimated at less than 3%. Registrar and Financial Intelligence Unit inspections in the Marshall Islands focus on licensed registered agents and regulated financial institutions rather than passive non-resident digital businesses.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act ('BCA'), Marshall Islands Revised Statutes (MIRS), Title 51, Chapter 1, as amended, specifically Sections 51.151 (Articles of Incorporation), 51.701 (Registered Agent), and 51.851 (Organization Meeting / First Board of Directors).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registrar, Corporations Registry, Ministry of Finance, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; filings are effected exclusively through a licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BCA-2), submitted with the written Consent of Registered Agent (Form BCA-3), and issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation by the Registrar.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; no escrow or capital-blocking rule applies. Authorized capital may be nominal (e.g., USD 1 paid-in against par value) and consideration may be cash, property, or services under the BCA. Annual franchise tax of USD 400 applies to non-resident corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BE IT RESOLVED: (1) The incorporator's subscription for 1,000 issued shares, par value USD 0.01 per share, be and the same is hereby accepted; the Secretary shall issue certificates upon receipt of aggregate par-value consideration. (2) The registered office shall be located at the principal office of the Corporation's duly appointed Registered Agent in Majuro, Marshall Islands, which agent is retained to accept service of process. (3) [Name] is elected President, [Name] is elected Secretary, and [Name] is elected Treasurer, each to serve at the pleasure of the Board. (4) The President is authorized to open bank accounts, engage payment processors, and execute all documents necessary to perfect the Corporation's formation and licensed operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registrar, RMI Corporations Registry, Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name-clearance request through the duly appointed Marshall Islands Registered Agent. The proposed name must end with 'Corporation', 'Inc.', 'Ltd.', or an approved corporate suffix and must be distinguishable from names already registered in the National Corporate Index. Obtain the Certificate of Name Availability.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or prohibited affix, file a written substituted name reservation within 5 business days; no additional government fee applies if the alternative is lodged in the same application cycle.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent (processing authority delegated by the Business Registrar)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered-agent service agreement designating the agent's principal office in Majuro as the Corporation's registered office and statutory service-of-process address. The agent executes the Consent of Registered Agent which is filed simultaneously with the Articles of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Details of registered office in Majuro
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the designated agent is not licensed or withdraws consent, promptly appoint a substitute licensed agent and file an amended consent with the Registrar before the Articles of Incorporation are submitted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public and corporate counsel; subsequently filed with the Business Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation in conformance with BCA Section 151, including: the corporate name, registered agent and office, authorized share classes and par value, a broad-purpose clause covering AI software development, video-synthesis platforms and virtual-avatar services, and the incorporator's subscription. Ensure the incorporator's signature is notarized.
required_dossiers: Preliminary draft of Bylaws for first-board adoption
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a technical objection, file Articles of Correction under Section 158 of the BCA within the statutory correction window; deficiencies identified pre-filing are cured by amending the draft at no cost.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing, Fee Payment, and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registrar, RMI Corporations Registry, Majuro (physical and electronic filing accepted)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Transmit the notarized Articles of Incorporation together with the Consent of Registered Agent to the Corporations Registry exactly as approved in name clearance. Pay the USD 150 state filing fee (plus agent disbursement charges if any) by bank transfer or approved electronic gateway. Retrieve the endorsed Certificate of Incorporation as conclusive evidence of corporate existence.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond in writing to the Registrar's query letter within 20 calendar days; a resubmission fee is charged only where a new name or a substantive re-filing is required, otherwise the defect is cured without penalty.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Meeting, First Board Resolution, and Initial Share Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Corporation (internal corporate organ)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting in person, by telephone, or by unanimous written consent in lieu of a meeting. Adopt the Bylaws; ratify the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution appointing the initial officers; approve the issuance of founder share certificates and designate the Corporation's principal bank and SaaS payment processors.
required_dossiers: First board meeting minutes or unanimous written consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an officer nominee is unavailable or disqualified, the incorporator may appoint a substitute director by written consent; all ratification signatures must be affixed before the minutes are filed in the corporate records book.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable to a non-resident software publisher. For any physical office presence, the general business licensing body is the Office of Commerce and Investment, Ministry of Finance, Majuro; no industrial manufacturing board has jurisdiction over AIGC video-synthesis software.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating or manufacturing permit is required; an optional General Business License (office-only) may be obtained for a Majuro physical office, and the Corporation remains a zero-footprint offshore entity if no physical presence is established.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI-EPA), established under the RMI Environmental Protection Act 1989, Title 24 of the MIRS
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - Category IV (virtual software operation with no land disturbance, no physical installation, and no point-source discharge; no EIA report or registration certificate required)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or particulate emissions are generated. Office waste, if any, must be managed under RMI-EPA solid-waste regulations and Majuro municipal ordinances; e-waste from any offshore AI GPU servers is handled solely by the cloud hosting provider and is outside RMI jurisdiction.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not mandatory for the non-resident entity. If a Majuro office is opened, the following clearances apply in the following order: fire safety inspection from the Majuro Fire Department and RMI National Disaster Management Office; workplace registration and occupational health compliance under the RMI Occupational Health and Safety Act 2007, administered by the Ministry of Health and Human Services; and structural load inspection for any server or storage rooms. None of these clearances is required for the offshore, cloud-hosted SaaS operation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance of the Republic of the Marshall Islands — Revenue and Taxation Division (RTD), Majuro; corporate registry filings: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI Registry (https://www.rmioc.com).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Incorporate MH_BC as a non-resident Business Corporation under the Business Corporations Act through the Office of the Registrar of Corporations, appointing a licensed RMI registered agent. Because the corporation derives no Marshall Islands-source income and transacts entirely offshore, no TIN, VAT registration, or income-tax file is required by RTD. Annual compliance consists of the Economic Substance Declaration, the registry renewal fee, and maintenance of a Certificate of Good Standing. A TIN and employer registration with the RMI Social Security Administration are required only if the company later employs RMI-resident workers or establishes a physical office in the Republic.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box classification regime exists under RMI law. A Business Corporation is automatically classified as non-resident and tax-exempt under Section 191 of the Business Corporations Act unless it elects, by board resolution and commencement of RMI-source business activity, to be treated as a resident taxable corporation. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available; RMI applies domestic nexus rules and relies on OECD BEPS-compliant economic substance declarations.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT or GST in force. The indirect tax architecture comprises customs import duties assessed on the CIF value of physical imports (HTS-based ad valorem rates including a general basic rate of approximately 10%, with higher specific rates on alcohol, tobacco, and fuel) and municipal business license fees. Digital SaaS exports by a non-resident corporation fall outside all RMI indirect taxes.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable: no VAT/GST registration threshold exists. Customs duty liability arises only when physical goods are imported into RMI territory. A municipal business license fee is triggered only upon establishment of a local place of business. A pure offshore MH_BC is subject solely to the annual non-resident corporation registry fee.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping, or digital fiscal-authority approval regime exists. Importers lodge a customs entry and certified manifest electronically with RTD Customs; duty is paid on the declared CIF value before release. Invoices for AI SaaS exports require no government clearance and are substantiated by payment-rail settlement records (Stripe/Paddle).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: RMI taxation is territorial: a non-resident Business Corporation is exempt from income tax under Section 191 of the Business Corporations Act, and AI avatar video-generation SaaS supplied to non-RMI customers is outside the RMI tax base, attracting no income tax, VAT, or customs duty. No zero-rating claim or refund is required. Eligibility is evidenced by: non-resident classification; management and control exercised outside the RMI; customers located and services consumed outside the RMI; no RMI fixed place of business; and annual economic substance certification. RMI imposes no exchange-control repatriation mandate; the 180-day window below reflects standard sanctions and treasury due-diligence practice.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: No RMI customs export declaration is required for intangible AI SaaS supplies (no physical goods cross the RMI border)
Executed SaaS Master Subscription Agreement confirming offshore delivery of AI video-generation services to non-RMI customers
USD-denominated commercial invoice issued by MH_BC, referencing plan, renewal period, and payment-transaction ID
Stripe or Paddle settlement statement evidencing receipt of subscription consideration into an offshore bank account
Annual RMI Economic Substance Declaration attesting continued non-resident tax-exempt status
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: RTD and the RMI economic substance filing authority may audit the exemption. If management and control are found to have been exercised in the Marshall Islands, services are shown to have been supplied to or consumed by RMI parties, or a tax-exempt status is falsely claimed, the exemption is revoked retrospectively, the company is reclassified as a resident taxable corporation, and full Income Tax Act 1989 liability for open years is assessed, plus interest and late-payment penalties up to a 25% statutory cap. False economic substance declarations attract fines of up to USD 10,000 per violation, revocation of the Certificate of Good Standing, deregistration risk, and consequent KYC de-risking by Stripe/Paddle.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: No central bank exists in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). Banking regulation and foreign financial oversight are exercised by the Banking Commissioner under the Ministry of Finance, established by the Banking Act 1991. The United States Federal Reserve System acts as the de facto monetary authority through official dollarization, with the U.S. dollar as the sole legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility exists for both capital and current account transactions because the U.S. dollar is the domestic currency. There are no exchange controls, no differential treatment between current and capital account flows, and no profit remittance hurdles. Dividends, royalties, loan repayments, and capital repatriation can be freely remitted in USD without any exchange allocation requirement, subject only to standard AML/CTF due diligence and compliance with the RMI Banking Act, the Financial Transactions Reporting Act, and international sanctions obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no surrender requirement on export proceeds. All export receipts may be retained in USD, freely used, and remitted without central bank approval or administrative license.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam — Marshall Islands Branch

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. The RMI has no regulated fintech or Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing framework. Offshore digital EMIs are not authorized to hold bank accounts or provide payment services in RMI unless separately licensed under the Banking Act or registered as a money transmitter. For an AI video SaaS company, the preferred structure is a USD-denominated treasury account at an RMI licensed commercial bank connected to U.S. correspondent banking rails; engaging unlicensed EMIs creates reputational, sanctions, and regulatory blocking risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: RMI AML rules do not statutorily require physical attendance for every customer, but licensed banks generally require at least one director or beneficial owner to attend an in-person interview at a branch or to execute verification before an RMI notary or recognized consular officer. Remote online opening may be permitted only for clearly low-risk corporate entities, subject to enhanced due diligence, liveness-verified video interviews, certified corporate documents, and independent source-of-funds verification. In practice, a physical or notarial appearance is the dominant standard.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity or nominee shareholder structures
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified register of directors and shareholders; full beneficial ownership chain to every natural person holding 25% or more; government-issued passport copies; proof of residential address; corporate registry extract; certificate of good standing; and a written UBO attestation signed by a director.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of committed capital derived from overseas SaaS revenues
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Banked source-of-funds statements showing the capital trail; audited or management-prepared financial statements; executed client agreements from the AI avatar platform; invoice and payment transaction logs from Stripe/Paddle; tax receipt or tax residency certificate; and a detailed capital account statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, PEP, or adverse media screening results
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Negative sanctions/PEP screening reports from a reputable screening provider; UBO nationality and residence documentation; adverse media settlement statement; and, if a PEP is identified, a source-of-wealth report plus senior approval from the bank’s compliance committee.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: AI software export-control and regulatory exposure in target markets
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export classification memorandum under applicable U.S./EU and Marshall Islands rules; jurisdiction-by-jurisdiction restricted-party screening; privacy policy and GDPR-style compliance assessment; AI ethics and acceptable-use policy; and a legal opinion confirming that no statutory license is required for AI video generation software under ISIC 6201.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border payment gateway flows classified as higher-risk digital business
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: End-customer due diligence sampling; recurring subscription contract template; chargeback and refund policy with historical statistics; compliance program manual covering transaction monitoring; and a liquidity reserve policy to demonstrate predictable treasury flows.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections must be made in USD via SWIFT MT103 wire transfer to the RMI business corporation's designated account at a licensed RMI bank, using a U.S. correspondent bank and either the Federal Reserve Fedwire or CHIPS clearing system. The payment reference should include the corporate name, bank account number, and a clear purpose description such as "share subscription / capital contribution under Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act". The bank will require a certified board resolution authorizing the capital injection, executed share subscription documents, plus AML/EDD evidence confirming the source of funds. There are no RMI-specific purpose codes, but the wire should carry a standard SPRO or beneficiary-entity reference to avoid rejected USD clearing.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements for trade settlements use USD-cleared correspondent banking rails, primarily SWIFT MT103 for operating expenses, invoice payments, dividend remittances, and service fees, and Commercial Letters of Credit (L/C) for purchases of physical hardware, software localization services, or strategic investments. For USD-denominated disbursements, ACH and Fedwire are available through the RMI bank’s U.S. correspondent. All outbound payments must be supported by underlying contracts, invoices, and treasury records; dividend payments require a board resolution declaring the dividend and a compliance review confirming absence of outstanding liabilities. No RMI exchange control approval is required.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Franchise Tax Renewal (Business Corporations Act 1990, Section 107)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due within 90 days after the last day of the anniversary month of incorporation each calendar year; a 60-day extension is available via Form 915 upon payment of a USD 200 extension fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: USD 200 late penalty imposed immediately after the 90-day window; continued non-filing for two consecutive periods authorizes the Registrar to administratively dissolve and strike off the company, causing loss of legal capacity, vesting of assets in the Republic, and costly reinstatement proceedings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Continuation of Licensed Registered Agent and Registered Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent (private statutory agent regulated under the Registered Agents Act 2011)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Maintained continuously from incorporation; agent engagement is renewed annually in conjunction with the Annual Report cycle on the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Absence of a licensed resident agent destroys good standing and constitutes a statutory ground for involuntary dissolution by the Registrar; the entity may also be suspended from transacting business

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Declaration of Authorized Share Structure, Director Details, and Registered Office Address (embodied in the Annual Report Form)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same statutory window as the Annual Report, i.e., within 90 days after the last day of the anniversary month of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: False or incomplete particulars constitute a criminal offence under the Business Corporations Act; share transfers and director changes remain unperfected against third parties until the corporate record is updated

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a private non-resident Business Corporation (ISIC 6201). No asset, revenue, or employee threshold triggers a statutory audit under the Business Corporations Act 1990. A certified audit is mandatory only for (i) issuers listed on the Marshall Islands Stock Exchange, (ii) licensed banking, insurance, or trust institutions, and (iii) entities specifically ordered by the Registrar or a court. The AI avatar video generation SaaS entity carries zero statutory audit obligation.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutorily imposed accounting framework for non-resident Business Corporations; books are typically kept under IFRS or US GAAP for investor and transfer-pricing documentation. The Business Corporations Act merely requires correct and complete books of account and minutes of proceedings; records may be maintained outside the Marshall Islands with the written consent of the registered agent.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands maintains no public or government-administered beneficial ownership register for Business Corporations. Under the Registered Agents Act 2011, the licensed registered agent must collect, verify, and continuously refresh ultimate beneficial ownership information under AML/CFT standards. The company must notify the agent within 14 days of any shareholding transfer producing a UBO change and must respond to the agent's annual KYC refresher; no form or fee is filed with the Registrar.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (share ledger with transfer history)
Books of Account and underlying financial records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable - no statutory audit required; voluntary IFRS/US GAAP audit typically USD 5,000 - USD 15,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% - the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) imposes no corporate income tax; a Non-Resident Business Corporation (BC) is fully tax-exempt on foreign-source and RMI-source passive income, subject only to the annual franchise/listing fee.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective CIT on AIGC SaaS revenue; statutory incentives include: (i) complete territorial exemption for non-resident BCs under the Income Tax Act, (ii) no capital gains tax, no net worth tax, no VAT/GST/sales tax, no payroll tax, and (iii) a fixed annual government fee of USD 350 (authorized capital 50,000 shares or fewer) or USD 500 (authorized capital above 50,000 shares). Loss carryforward rules are legally moot because the CIT base is zero.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Annual Report Form (Registrar of Corporations Form AR) together with the prescribed Annual Listing Fee, submitted through the RMI National Registrar's e-filing platform or a licensed RMI Registered Agent (Marshall Islands Association portal). No corporate income tax return exists for a non-resident BC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The Annual Report is due on or before the last day of the month containing the anniversary of incorporation; the Annual Listing Fee is due concurrently. For any entity momentarily deriving RMI-source gross revenue, the gross revenue tax return and payment deadline is 30 April of the calendar year following the tax year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name as shown on the Certificate of Incorporation, including the word 'Corporation' or an approved abbreviation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact registered English legal name; a foreign trade name or DBA is optional and not tax-relevant for the RMI filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and physical address of the RMI-licensed resident agent maintained in Majuro.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must hold an active RMI license and executes the e-filing on behalf of the foreign shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Street address of the registered office in the RMI, which may be the resident agent's office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A post office box alone is insufficient; the agent's physical street address satisfies this field.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and residential addresses of all incumbent directors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Natural persons of any nationality or corporate entities may serve; non-resident directorships are permitted and create no RMI tax nexus.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names and residential addresses of the President, Secretary, and Treasurer or equivalent officers.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: One person may hold all officer positions; disclosure of non-resident officers triggers no additional RMI tax liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of authorized shares, par value, and aggregate authorized capital determining the fee bracket.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Maintain authorized capital at or below 50,000 shares to remain in the USD 350 annual listing fee tier.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration stating whether any gross revenue was derived from RMI sources during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select 'Non-Resident / No RMI-Source Revenue' to preserve the 0% CIT position and to avoid the 3% gross revenue tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of the annual listing fee or franchise tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay the applicable USD 350 or USD 500 fee by wire transfer to the RMI Registrar; non-payment triggers default and dissolution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or omitted Annual Report and Annual Listing Fee filings trigger: (i) monthly late monetary penalties, (ii) a 30-day default notice and administrative dissolution of the corporation by the Registrar, (iii) loss of the corporate name and vesting of the company's RMI property in the State, and (iv) a requirement to pay all arrears plus reinstatement fees as a condition of revival. Officers who willfully certify false filings are personally liable to penalty under the Business Corporations Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the RMI imposes no withholding tax on dividends at the statutory level; distributions declared by a Non-Resident Business Corporation to foreign shareholders are entirely free of RMI tax and no withholding return or payment is required.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The RMI has no comprehensive double taxation agreement applicable to this entity, and because the domestic dividend WHT rate is already 0%, treaty relief infrastructure is unnecessary in the RMI. Where an overseas payor withholds on payments routed to the RMI entity, the company should obtain a Tax Residency Certificate or Tax Exemption Certificate from the RMI Tax Office by submitting: (i) the Certificate of Incorporation, (ii) proof of current Annual Report filing, and (iii) a director resolution certifying beneficial ownership, then present the certificate to the foreign payor together with the applicable foreign beneficial-owner form (for US payors, Form W-8BEN-E).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory RMI withholding tax is 0% on cross-border royalties and 0% on debt interest paid to or by a non-resident BC; absent any DTA, the effective rate remains 0% for inbound and outbound IP licensing, AI software subscription revenue, and intercompany financing transactions.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 0 - no mandatory RMI transfer pricing documentation regime applies to a non-resident BC deriving no RMI-source revenue; a de facto documentation threshold of USD 500,000 in annual related-party transactions is recommended to defend the 0% tax position under OECD alignment, while a 3% gross revenue tax exposure, if triggered, requires arm's-length substantiation for related-party revenue above USD 100,000.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI applies OECD-aligned Economic Substance Regulations for entities performing 'relevant activities,' which include IP holding, distribution, and financing or licensing arrangements resembling a SaaS model. An AI Avatar video generation company that licenses or monetizes software intellectual property through the RMI BC must demonstrate: (i) a physical RMI office and premises, (ii) local full-time employees or qualifying expenditure proportionate to revenue, (iii) board meetings and strategic decisions taking place in the RMI, and (iv) adequate operating expenditure and assets maintained in the RMI. Non-compliance results in declaration as a shell entity, monetary penalties, automatic exchange of information with foreign tax authorities, and potential re-attribution of profits to the ultimate beneficial owner's jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing a false Annual Report, concealing RMI-source gross revenue, or falsely declaring non-resident status while deriving income through RMI-based AI SaaS activities subject to the 3% gross revenue tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Income Tax Act, civil penalty of up to 100% of the tax evaded plus a criminal fine and imprisonment for a term fixed by the court (up to several years); the Registrar may administratively dissolve the corporation and impose compounded late fees and reinstatement charges.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierced for fraud or false certification: directors and signatories are jointly and severally liable for the evaded tax, penalties, and restitution to affected customers and investors; courts may issue travel bans, asset freezes, and custodial sentences against directors personally.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a pure intangible-routing shell: the RMI BC holds the AI video software and SaaS contracts while development, management, and operational decision-making occur entirely outside the RMI.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Economic Substance Regulations and OECD BEPS Action 5 exchange framework, the entity is reclassified as a shell; the RMI Tax Office may impose financial penalties of USD 10,000 to USD 100,000 per year of non-compliance, exchange information with foreign tax authorities, and the Registrar may strike the company for default.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorize a shell structure without substance are personally exposed to penalty assessments in the shareholder's home jurisdiction through CFC and exit-tax rules, and to mismanagement claims under the Business Corporations Act; foreign courts may issue director travel bans and worldwide freezing orders in aid of enforcement.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering / AML Violations (AI-Generated Deepfake Fraud)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the RMI entity and Stripe or Paddle payment rails to collect or launder proceeds from fraud perpetrated with AI-generated avatar video content (including impersonation scams, synthetic identity fraud, and deceptive political advertising), or failing to maintain AML customer due diligence records while acting as a payment intermediary.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Money Laundering (Prevention and Control) Act, as amended, laundering criminal proceeds attracts a monetary penalty of up to USD 1,000,000 or twice the value of the property laundered, whichever is greater, and/or imprisonment; the Supreme Court may order forfeiture of assets, and payment processors may permanently terminate the merchant account and file suspicious activity reports with foreign financial intelligence units.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Director-level liability attaches where directors knowingly participate in or benefit from the laundering scheme; the corporate veil is pierced, directors are personally liable to victims for restitution, and courts may issue travel bans, arrest warrants, and extradition requests under RMI mutual legal assistance procedures.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the BC to misappropriate investor funds, issue sham shares, certify false solvency statements to obtain credit, or strip assets while leaving AI SaaS customers and Stripe or Paddle chargebacks unpaid.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Business Corporations Act and Penal Code, fraudulent trading is a criminal offense: the court may order compulsory winding-up, claw back assets, impose equitable compensation equal to the loss caused, freeze bank accounts, and fine the company up to the value of the assets misappropriated.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed misleading statements or approved wrongful distributions bear unlimited personal liability for the company's debts, must make full civil restitution to creditors and customers, face termination of the RMI resident-agent relationship, and are subject to international asset tracing, travel restrictions, and possible extradition where assets are moved abroad.
